rv.q: Not since The Boy From Oz have we seen the potential for another Australian musical classic, but Whispering Jack may just be the one.
The musical principally tells the story of Farnham's 80s career comeback, with abundant humour and heart.
WHISPERING JACK, THE John Farnham MUSICAL is a captivating New Australian musical which we need more of. It is entertaining, educational and strikes the right balance of fun and emotional engagement.
With Whispering Jack , Paynter proves it can carry on.
Fortunately, director Mitchell Butel pulls out all the stops to deliver an exuberantly entertaining production, brimming with passion yet never succumbing to excessive earnestness.

ta: Pier 4/5, 15 Hickson Road, Walsh Bay, Sydney NSW 2000
